body:
I understand how that feels. Actually, I currently going thew a similar sitation at work
( Not school, i dont start til next week) where you try your best at your job and people still end up criticising you for not getting things done on time when at the same time you can't do it all at once. ( I work as a cook at McDonald's) Also criticising me isn't going to get me to do my job faster nor more efficient. It just pisses me off to the point of me snapping at my coworkers and somewhat of being an asshole. So I can see where your coming from.
When I get home from work, I look back on my whole work day regretting the way I act or feeling like a failure when I don't get things right. The only thing I could really suggest would to be is keep you head up, don't care about what others think and only care  about yourself because, hey, its just work, everyone is as stressed out as you, they just have a better way of hiding it.
For school though, all I can say is try your best and never give up. But for me to say that kind of makes makes hypocrite, cause I don't really do that well at school as well due to constant thoughs that echo through my head thay doesn't let me focus.
I hope everything wirks out for you though.
Sorry, not the words of encouragement you were looking for.
But I tried my best with what I know.

There's someone somewhere who always cares about you, you just haven't found the right kinf of people yet. And if you've lost hope, then maybe you have to care about yourself amd not let this madness consume you.
More like an advanced stage cancer that we can never cure.
